title: Placement validation admits a fast-class leaf on a slow-class vertex
description: Reviewed 3a5abda184dc9d9f3da993482292b6880fdf62f3. validator/src/topology.rs:91-102 checks adjacency without checking resolved operand classes. For a target with vertex 0 slow, vertex 1 fast and X times fast=1/slow=100, expand(X,[fast]) followed by check_leaves(leaves,[0]) succeeds. aggregate also succeeds with fast live intervals, reporting time=1 and fast peak=1 for an operation actually assigned to a slow vertex. This admits an impossible class binding and a 100-fold wrong time; ISA 0.9 §8.3 and §11 require placement classes to match each resolved wire. Repro: timeout 120s cargo test --offline --manifest-path /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-targets/.tmp/rev-targets/repro/Cargo.toml -j4 --test review -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture; explicit_placement_must_match_resolved_class fails after successful expansion, placement check and aggregation. Preserve and validate the resolved class binding through leaf placement, including ancillae, and test mismatched explicit placements.
close_reason: Fixed: Leaf records resolved operand classes; check_leaves rejects a wire on a vertex of another class and two wires of one expansion on one vertex. Test validator/tests/review_round2.rs::placement_must_match_the_resolved_operand_class.

title: Azure importer silently rounds exact source failure rates
description: Reviewed 3a5abda184dc9d9f3da993482292b6880fdf62f3. validator/src/importers.rs:14 canonicalizes unchecked rate numbers copied at lines 269-276, changing the exact values consumed by estimates. Input oneQubitGateErrorRate=0.10000000000000001 imports successfully but its X-leaf cost becomes 0.1; positive 1e-400 becomes zero in both target costs and the quantities report (CLI exit 0). ISA 0.9 §8.1 gives numeric text exact rational meaning; source.input_json retaining the original text does not repair the consumed target cost. Repro: timeout 120s cargo test --offline --manifest-path /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-targets/.tmp/rev-targets/repro/Cargo.toml -j4 --test review -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture; azure_numeric_rates_must_not_change_on_serialization fails with 1/10 versus 10000000000000001/100000000000000000. Also ran the built validator import-azure targets/ideal-all-to-all.json .tmp/rev-targets/azure-underflow.json under timeout: exit 0, emitted source-positive rate 0. Fix exact numeric preservation; add independent rate precision/underflow tests.
close_reason: Fixed: importer preserves every imported number exactly or fails loudly (rate_parts per field; finish() over the whole target). Test validator/tests/review_round2.rs::imported_rates_are_preserved_exactly_or_rejected; CLI import of .tmp/rev-targets/azure-underflow.json now exits 1.

title: Native matching emits executable leaves with impossible operand arities
description: Reviewed 3a5abda184dc9d9f3da993482292b6880fdf62f3. validator/src/runtime.rs:151-152 infers the native opcode control count without checking the number of resolved operands; the direct native branch at lines 61-69 likewise accepts an empty class slice. A loaded swap scheme containing {gate:cx,wires:[t]} expands successfully to cx wires=[0], although ISA 0.9 §4.4 CX needs two wires. On the shipped ideal target, expand(x,[],0,0,eps=0,None) also returns a successful X leaf with no target. These are structural failures, independent of the target author proving a scheme unitary correct. Repro: timeout 120s cargo test --offline --manifest-path /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-targets/.tmp/rev-targets/repro/Cargo.toml -j4 --test review -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture; template_native_operand_arity_must_reject and native_operand_arity_must_reject both fail, printing the malformed successful leaves. Reject impossible opcode/operand/control/parameter arities before returning executable native or template leaves.
close_reason: Fixed: native_parameters enforces §4.4 own controls and c+targets operands (covers expand native branch, templates, Target::native). Test validator/tests/review_round2.rs::native_operand_arity_is_checked.

title: Decimal parser accepts malformed durations by deleting every decimal point
description: Reviewed 3a5abda184dc9d9f3da993482292b6880fdf62f3. validator/src/expr.rs:18-21 derives the scale from the first dot and then removes all dots, without validating the numeric grammar. Azure oneQubitGateTime="1.2.3 us" imports successfully as 0.000000123 seconds instead of reporting malformed input; decimal("1.2.3") is silently interpreted as 0.123. This parser is also exposed through CLI eval binding strings. Repro: timeout 120s cargo test --offline --manifest-path /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-targets/.tmp/rev-targets/repro/Cargo.toml -j4 --test review -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture; malformed_decimal_duration_must_reject fails with seconds=1.23e-7. Validate the full decimal/scientific-notation grammar before constructing its exact rational; cover malformed bindings and duration numbers.
close_reason: Fixed: expr::decimal admits only the JSON number grammar. Test validator/tests/review_round2.rs::malformed_decimal_text_rejects.

title: Closed target schema rejects the published native realisation model field
description: Reviewed 3a5abda184dc9d9f3da993482292b6880fdf62f3. validator/src/target.rs:187 allows only params on a native gate, so a conformant ISA 0.9 §8.3 X entry with realisation_model (bennett.native-model/1, exact X matrix, controlled_U, resolved operand_map=[0], controls 0..0) returns unknown field realisation_model. K86 explicitly requires closed-schema target readers to be upgraded. This refuses published target capability and prevents targets carrying independent native-operation evidence from reaching consumers. Repro: timeout 120s cargo test --offline --manifest-path /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-targets/.tmp/rev-targets/repro/Cargo.toml -j4 --test review -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture; published_native_model_must_load fails with Err("§8.3 schema: unknown field realisation_model"). The complete input is in .tmp/rev-targets/repro/tests/review.rs. Add current model-schema/version reporting and independent admission tests without substituting an ideal operation for an unsupported model.
close_reason: Fixed: gates admit realisation_model; validator/src/model.rs checks bennett.native-model/1 against the accepted field set, tolerates-and-verifies operand_map (b-isa-spec-wk0k still open), rejects -X etc. at zero epsilon; unpublished encodings -> b-targets-1wr. Test validator/tests/review_round2.rs::published_native_realisation_model_loads_and_is_verified.

title: K86 encodings unpublished: explicit control_models and non-matrix data; validator rejects them loudly
description: ISA 0.9 §8.3 K86 names 'Explicit control models give the full context matrix' and data that 'may additionally supply closed rational interval enclosures' (and Kraus/instrument representations alongside U), but publishes JSON encodings only for control_models {kind:controlled_U,controls:c,disabled:identity} and data.matrix. validator/src/model.rs therefore rejects any other control_models or data key with a message citing this bead. Needed: the spec publishes those encodings (a b-isa-spec bead for the editor), then the validator admits them. Also: operand_map is tolerated-and-verified pending b-isa-spec-wk0k (accepted field set excludes it). Found by opus-targets-r2 while fixing b-targets-z7b.

title: Define import of probabilistic hardware errors and QEC models
description: North Star §7: "target-description format accepts imported models, converting units where they align ... otherwise importing them as new named resources." §8.1 defines epsilon as achieved approximation error; physical failure probabilities and QEC/factory formulas are not that metric. Need declared stochastic error/resource semantics and hierarchy/code-distance bindings for Azure/Qualtran hardware models; never substitute failure probability for operator-norm error.
notes: 2026-11-01: §8.3 imports plus North Star §7 decide numeric quantities, so Azure failure rates (including nonzero and Majorana) import as named count resources, never epsilon. Still undecided: qecScheme formulas, code distance, factories, symbolic counts. Exact proposed text is in b-isa-spec-fd0; those inputs stay loud errors.

title: Define topology schema for hardware targets
description: §8.2 says: "gates on disjoint wires MAY overlap unless max_parallel or a topology is declared"; §8.3 lists no topology field or connectivity/placement semantics. Need physical vertices/edges, addressable class assignment and routing validation to express a superconducting 2D grid without pretending all-to-all.
